items.detail: The **Nasdaq** fell **4.5%** this week, its worst week since June, while the S&P 500 lost about 2%, both closing near their lows Friday.
items.why: Fears about debt-funded AI spending, focused on CoreWeave, and China's progress in memory chips hit chipmakers hardest.

items.detail: Inflation data came in hot midweek: September consumer prices rose **3.7%** from a year earlier, and producer prices jumped **6.3%**.
items.why: Oil prices driven by the Iran war kept Brent above $105 and pushed gasoline sharply higher.

items.detail: Odds of an October Fed hike neared even after the CPI report, then fell to about **15%** by Friday, with the 10-year yield near 5.08%.
items.why: Money moved from tech stocks into bonds, and Fed Chair Warsh refused to signal another hike.

items.detail: The **MSCI Emerging Markets** index had its steepest weekly drop since March, led by Korea's Kospi, which fell below **6,000** in two separate 7% routs.
items.why: China's memory-chip advance and doubts about AI spending led foreigners to dump Samsung and SK Hynix.

items.detail: The **Nifty** gained about **2.8%** this week to close at 23,146, defying the global selloff after a weak Monday.
items.why: Strong results from HCL Tech, Wipro and Tech Mahindra lifted IT stocks, and cheaper crude helped late in the week.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** fell about **3%** this week and entered a correction on Wednesday, erasing Thursday's bounce by Friday.
items.why: Yields above 5% hurt small companies with floating-rate debt, and the AI selloff spread to them.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** ended the week near **$81,500**, failing to break higher but holding $80,000 support after the hot CPI report.
items.why: Fed hike fears and ETF outflows capped rallies, while Warsh's silence on hikes steadied buyers.

items.detail: **Ether** ended the week near **$2,409**, after a brief bounce to $2,533 faded and it briefly fell below $2,400.
items.why: Leveraged bets were wiped out after CPI, and US spot ether ETFs saw outflows again late in the week.

items.detail: **Solana** fell about **5%** this week to near **$104**, just above $100 ahead of Tuesday's Alpenglow upgrade.
items.why: US Solana ETFs saw nine straight days of outflows, outweighing excitement about the upgrade.

items.detail: **Gold** slipped about **0.5%** this week to near **$4,167**, as Thursday's rebound recovered most of a midweek slide.
items.why: The hot CPI report lifted yields and the dollar, then hot producer prices and falling yields drew inflation-hedge buyers.

crossCuttingTheme: Doubts about debt-funded AI spending, plus Iran-war oil pushing inflation to 3.7%, kept yields above 5% and Fed hike fears alive, hitting chipmakers from the Nasdaq to Seoul, along with small caps and crypto.
